slice: RPP-5dq ATTDEF physical-source profiles and host-tail routing

scope.hostTailFix: After embedded MTEXT exists, ATTRIB/ATTDEF group 73 remains host field length and group 74 remains host vertical alignment, not nested MTEXT line spacing or an ignored tag
scope.profileAudit: Distinct original-scalar inventory after immutable callback pairing and shared-decoder modeled replay, never another payload decoder
scope.spanContents: Exact original raw group index/code, host/nested scope, field class, reference role and numeric handle; names remain indexed into owned raw groups
scope.opaqueLimit: Opaque application handles are inventoried and retained, not a qualified target role, namespace or graph binding
scope.routing: Application metadata follows nested MTEXT after its creation even after the attribute subclass; XDATA always belongs to the host
scope.admittedForms: Classic AC1021/AC1024/AC1027/AC1032, and bounded AC1032 embedded 101 / explicit legacy-100 compatibility profiles; attribute tails may precede or follow the nested object
scope.compatibilityLimit: Earlier-version multiline imports retain modeled compatibility but receive no physical-profile certificate. Legacy 100 is explicitly a bounded compatibility spelling, not independently documented semantic support.
scope.refusedForms: Unmodeled/unknown fields or subclasses, secondary AcDbXrecord attributes, ambiguous dual 280 version/lock fields, unmodeled columns, unsupported type/placeholder placements, duplicates, malformed scopes/coordinates/proxy counts/XDATA and lossy unknown line weights
scope.computedPolicy: Known read-only MTEXT extents and an explicit zero placeholder are classified separately from unknown payload; no arbitrary ignored tag is admitted
scope.accounting: Precharge one span per raw group, fixed 8192 logical grammar-work allowance, linear raw-byte/group work and existing shared byte/work ceilings before allocation; sticky budget/allocation failure; unsupported profiles publish no partial span vector
scope.accountingLimit: Logical conservative allowances, not exact capacity/RSS/all process allocations or a strict CPU theorem

redBaseline.message: ATTDEF source: ATTDEF field length and vertical alignment belong to the host, not nested MTEXT
redBaseline.scope: Host-tail regression before the two-case routing fix; not a baseline run of the later complete physical audit

owningControlsPerConfiguration.profileAxes: Four modern revisions x ASCII/Binary x BLOCKS/ENTITIES x classic/101-before-tail/legacy100-before-tail/101-after-tail forms

owningControlsPerConfiguration.observerCorruptions: Change original-span scope, role, handle value or group index, four per admitted import
owningControlsPerConfiguration.oversizedChunkAxes: 128 and 255 bytes, separately in proxy group 310 and XDATA group 1004, across every admitted version/form/encoding/section profile
owningControlsPerConfiguration.oversizedChunkPublication: Neither ATTDEF source nor typed callback is delivered; corrected fresh data/session import succeeds on the same adapter
owningControlsPerConfiguration.negativeSchedules: 29 common schedules x four forms x both encodings/sections, plus seven nested-only schedules x three forms x both encodings/sections
owningControlsPerConfiguration.failureCoverage: Ignored/unknown payload, duplicated same/changing fields, secondary/version forms, application scope/role confusion, orphan/malformed/interrupted XDATA later sanitized by parsing, nested fields/columns and lossy line-weight normalization
owningControlsPerConfiguration.callbackFieldFaultScope: One canonical profile, not the complete version/profile/field Cartesian product
owningControlsPerConfiguration.allocationLimit: Every observed allocation in each calibrated canonical interval, not every process/import allocation
owningControlsPerConfiguration.quotaRecovery: Successful quota and replay/allocation recovery additionally requires a complete admitted physical audit

boundaryInvestigation.initialHypothesis: A one-byte binary chunk length might justify a 255-byte admitted source chunk
boundaryInvestigation.redNormalAndAsanOwning: Each passed 3/4; the maximum-255 positive failed before ATTDEF publication. These are investigation controls, not a new production defect.
boundaryInvestigation.resolution: Revert the temporary audit-only widening; retain the existing 127-byte reader/audit domain in both encodings, add 127-byte positives and 128/255-byte negative controls

primaryResearch.finding: Host attribute field length/alignment are distinct from nested MTEXT; the secondary section and repeated version/lock codes require explicit treatment, not ordinary last-value parsing
MTEXT line spacing, computed read-only extents and column data have separate meanings; an unknown column tag must not silently become a complete modeled source profile
The maintained peer implementation distinguishes R2018 embedded forms and records uncertainty about secondary Xrecord examples; source research is not an executed independent CAD semantic test
The binary chunk length is an unsigned byte; this carrier fact alone does not override the production reader's separate logical chunk bound or establish independent CAD acceptance
